title: Kirkjubøur Men's Softshell Jacket — with Hood and Fleece Lining, Black
short_description: Men's softshell jacket by Kirkjubøur in black: 95% polyester, 5% elastane, with hood, fleece lining and two zipped pockets.
long_description: The Kirkjubøur men's softshell jacket comes with a hood and fleece lining according to its title and is available in black. According to Amazon it is made of 95% polyester and 5% elastane. Amazon states a hydrostatic head of up to 10,000 mm and describes the jacket as breathable and water-repellent. A drawstring at the hem and an elastic arm closure help with the fit, and two zipped side pockets offer space for a phone, keys and small items. According to Amazon the brand logo is embroidered. The fit is straight and the jacket is listed in the winter collection for cold weather. Before buying, please check sizes and care instructions on the Amazon product page.
features: With hood and fleece lining, hydrostatic head up to 10,000 mm (according to Amazon)

buying_angle: Handy for anyone looking for a men's softshell jacket with a hood and fleece lining for cooler weather, who wants to check size and care instructions on Amazon before buying.
